observations.own_observations: Hatchet Lake and a distinct Phillips Lake label are both implicated by the selected Hatchet-region ring; Corson and LeDrew remain outside. Charcoal Lake is directly labelled on the northeast-oriented selected water, with Daschuk separately east and Kingston, Gibson, Sava and other waters around it. Thin southwestern Charcoal water and part of the southeastern lobe extend beyond the ring.

complete_feature_observations.independent_observation: The full selected ring has a broad southwest basin, a long nearly straight northern edge, an inward northeast shoreline and a narrow southern tip. Both maps directly label its main water Hatchet Lake. The Elections map separately labels Phillips Lake on the northern/northwestern water implicated inside this generalized ring; WSA does not print that additional name. Corson Lake lies north/northwest and LeDrew Lake southwest, outside the selected footprint. The complete outline and surrounding waters support the Hatchet association, but the Phillips-labelled inclusion prevents a single name for the whole selected polygon. Label position alone does not establish the precise Hatchet-Phillips-Corson partitions.

The complete selected ring follows a broad east-west basin with two northwestern projections, a north-central indented shore and an eastern/southeastern hook. Both maps directly label this water Tazin Lake. Tsalwor Lake is separately labelled southwest/west of and outside the selected ring. The retained maps show a narrow northeastern/eastern extension and fine northern fingers beyond the generalized outline; islands and peninsula indentations are also simplified. The whole selected generalized footprint supports Tazin Lake, without certifying the full detailed named-lake extent.

The complete selected ring follows the southwest-to-northeast central Charcoal Lake basin and long northeastern arm, with a southwestern shoulder and southeastern notch. Both maps directly print Charcoal Lake over this water. Daschuk Lake lies separately to the east, Kingston Lake northwest, Gibson Lake south, Sava Lake southeast and Melnick Lake farther southeast; none is an alias. The narrow southwestern continuation and part of the southeastern lobe extend beyond the ring, while the northern fork, islands and fine shore indentations are simplified. Cochrane River is surrounding river context, not an alternative lake name.

source_group_limit: Three cartographic publications in two publisher groups. Shared underlying hydrographic data may exist; no formal naming registry was checked.
